title: Central Japan Railway Company Annual Report 2020
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.locator: Introducing New Shinkansen Rolling Stock N700S
passages.note: The operator dates the start of passenger service to July 2020, describes the prototype tests as informing production specifications, and describes the N700S as the replacement for the N700A-type fleet. It lists standardized design for flexible trainset lengths and battery self-movement.
